title: Knowledge service (OKS)
description: Connect the domain knowledge and read-only data declared by the session workspace. oks_jaq explores knowledge and processes data through resource references, JSON projection or jq files; saved results retain full provenance. Query Intents are validated before execution. Figures and XHTML reports reference saved materials, and reports inline display data, processing methods and provenance. The work_* tools manage code and report bodies under .work/ using complete workspace-relative paths. create_current_ctx_data provides time and time-zone materials; va_ask provides vocabulary leads. Deliverables can be viewed, pinned and cleaned up in the sidebar. The workspace oks.json declares the model, domain and data file.
